Aisha (PM): Hey team — we need to finalize the observability "visibility surface" scope for Q2 roadmap. Customers keep asking for cheaper debugging + cost attribution. Quick sync: what can we commit to for MVP? :eyes:
Connor (Eng): Recs — dashboards (per-route latency + p95/p99), lightweight tracing hooks (start/end spans), and a cost breakdown per-token per-route. All three are achievable but tracing hooks add infra complexity.
Priya (SRE): Agree dashboards + error analytics should be first. Tracing hooks need careful sampling to avoid perf hit. Default sample-rate 1%?
Marco (Design): We'll need a minimal console layout: 'Overview' (latency/cost/errors), 'Routes' (per-route), and 'Trace' panel (sampled spans). I can mock up low-fidelity screens by EOD.
Josh (Product Ops): Customers A, B asked for chargeback per-team — cost-per-route is critical. Can we do cost estimates rather than exact billing for MVP? :thinking_face:
Connor (Eng): Yes — approximate cost = tokens * model_unit_cost + infra_surcharge. We can show 'estimated $' in dashboard. Exact billing requires billing integration.
Aisha (PM): Good. Proposed MVP list:
```
- Route-level dashboards: p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput, error rate
- Estimated cost per route (30-day) with breakdown (model vs infra)
- Error analytics: grouped traces by exception + simple regression detection
- Tracing hooks: SDK-level decorators + 1% sampling, stored for 7 days
- Basic alerting: rate/error thresholds (UI + webhook)
```
Connor (Eng): Implementation notes: batching metrics, pre-aggregated windows (1m/5m), and ephemeral KV store for top routes. Storage cost estimate ~ 120GB/month for 30-day retention at current sampling.
Priya (SRE): Launch criteria suggestions:
```
- End-to-end latency < 100ms p95 for dashboard queries
- Tracing overhead < 2% CPU for sampled requests
- Cost estimates within ±15% of actual for top 90% routes
- Alerting delivery 99% success (webhook retries)
```
Marco (Design): UX acceptance: first-time flow to onboard a route, default dashboards auto-created, ability to hide sensitive routes.
Josh (Product Ops): Customer rollout plan: beta with 3 customers (A,B,C), collect feedback for 4 weeks, then GA. Need docs + runbook.
Aisha (PM): Tradeoffs: if tracing sampling causes perf, we can drop span capture to only error cases initially. Also consider making cost breakdown behind 'Advanced' toggle to speed rollout.
Connor (Eng): Question: do we instrument SDK only or also platform-side (ingress)? SDK-first gives fastest ship, but misses non-SDK traffic.
Priya (SRE): For GA we need both. MVP can be SDK-only but include ingress hooks as follow-up.
Aisha (PM): Decision (thumbs): SDK-only tracing for MVP, dashboards + cost estimates + error analytics. Follow-ups: ingress tracing, per-team billing, advanced alerting.
Marco (Design): I'll put together mockups and a handoff doc.
Connor (Eng): I'll draft an implementation plan with infra cost and milestones.
telemetry-bot: New telemetry feature flag created: feature/visibility-surface-mvp
Aisha (PM): Thanks — I'll update the roadmap doc and ping sales about beta invites. Any blockers?
Josh (Product Ops): Docs and onboarding runbook needed, and legal for data retention for traces.
Priya (SRE): I'll check retention policy compatibility and KMS needs.
Aisha (PM): Cool. I'll capture action items:
- Marco: mockups + handoff (due +1d)
- Connor: infra plan + cost (due +3d)
- Priya: retention/KMS validation (due +2d)
- Josh: beta cohort + runbook (due +4d)
- Aisha: update roadmap + notify GTM (due +1d)

Aisha (PM): End.
